task: Fix MCP OAuth2 auth callback timeout race in codemie-ui by aligning the callback timeout with backend PKCE lifetime and keeping auth_config_id tracked through the timeout/recoverable state across all three consumers of useAuthCallbackListener.

key_reasoning.reason: Shared cross-cutting hook useAuthCallbackListener plus its three divergently-wired consumers (useMCPAuthPrompt, useChatAuthCallbacks, WorkflowDetailsPage) plus mcpAuthInitiate.ts — one shared utility touching three independent frontend feature areas (MCP auth prompt, chat, workflow monitoring); bumped from base L via the 'affects multiple workflows' red flag.

Directly changes OAuth2 authentication callback tracking/timeout semantics with no exact existing precedent for a 'still tracked but recoverable' state, and 2 of the 3 consumers (useChatAuthCallbacks, WorkflowDetailsPage) currently have zero test coverage per technical-analysis.md, raising regression risk; bumped via the 'affects authentication' red flag.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L (4) to XL (5): change ripples through the shared useAuthCallbackListener hook into three independent, divergently-wired consumers (useMCPAuthPrompt, useChatAuthCallbacks, WorkflowDetailsPage) — analogous to affecting multiple workflows.
Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): change affects authentication/authorization callback tracking and timeout handling.
